name: Dalmia Bharat Ltd
title: Dalmia Bharat Ltd - 542216 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Dalmia Bharat (cement) posted record Q4 EBITDA of Rs 902 crore and FY26 EBITDA Rs 3,083 crore, but West Asia cost shock of Rs 125-150/ton hits Q1 and FY27 capex is Rs 3,200-3,400 crore with no new capacity announced.

capex.peers_comment: Industry adding 160-170 million ton capacity between FY26 and FY28; around 110-120 million ton still to come in next two years.
capex.quote: total capex outlook for FY27 being INR3,200 to INR3,400 crores

triggers.label: Industry adds 110-120 Mt over two years
triggers.quote: the balance of around 110 to 120-odd million ton of capacity is expected in the next 2 years

triggers.label: Incentives outstanding up to Rs 839 crore
triggers.quote: Total incentives outstanding at year-end has increased to INR839 crores

triggers.label: Kadapa commissioning slips to Q2-Q3 FY28
triggers.quote: we are confident that we will be able to commission this project somewhere between Q2 to Q3 of FY28

guidance.quote: In the next 8 to 9 quarters, we are looking forward to reach somewhere between 72 to 75 million tons of capacity
total capex outlook for FY27 being INR3,200 to INR3,400 crores

guidance.metric: Q1 FY27 cost increase vs Q4
guidance.quote: we are expecting an impact of somewhere between INR125 to INR150 per ton
we will always keep looking to deliver INR50 to INR100 cost take-out on an annual basis
we expect expansion linked cash outflow in FY27 to be in the range of INR2,200 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: we are confident that we will be able to commission this project somewhere between Q2 to Q3 of FY28
FY26 adjusted cost is lower by at least INR100 versus FY25

evasions.topic: Capacity beyond 75 Mt funding and location
evasions.quote: I think we can't talk right now. You know, we'll share with you whenever, we are ready.
Situation is quite dynamic from region-to-region, plant-to-plant. So giving any kind of guidance may not hold true
we don't share the capacity utilization for clinker and that too region -wise

red_flags.label: Receivables/incentives stretched: Rs 839 crore outstanding, Rs 14 crore collected in Q4
red_flags.quote: Total incentives outstanding at year-end has increased to INR839 crores, as collections for the quarter were subdued at just INR14 crores

red_flags.label: Capex cash deferred into payables
red_flags.quote: A lot of CWIP that we have incurred during the year is still standing as payable in our books
